newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open lower.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open lower.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open lower Monday, with sharp losses expected in platinum and palladium on talk that Japan could secure supplies from the free market amid continued delays in Russian metal shipments, traders said.
COMEX June gold was called off $0.50 to $1.00 from Friday's close of $343.90 an ounce after trading from $343.70 to $343.20 on ACCESS. Early bullion was quoted at $341.00/50.
COMEX July silver was called 1.00 to 2.00 cents lower.
